title: Teach Them to Make Their Own Pacts
coreMove: Guide a child to design a small pact they understand, own, and can adjust after seeing what happens.
sourcePressure: The child section adapts pact-making into guided self-authorship, preserving developmental limits while moving beyond imposed rules.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would make adult rules look like child-made commitments.

hook: Teach Them to Make Their Own Pacts as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: teen ceramic student preparing portfolio pieces
exampleSpecs.audience: mentor helping a teen pact against video breaks
exampleSpecs.stakes: portfolio quality depends on owned studio time
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the teen chooses to store earbuds in the glaze cabinet until two handles are attached
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A glaze cabinet tag hangs beside two unfinished cup handles.

exampleSpecs.domain: young soccer referee studying rules before weekend games
exampleSpecs.audience: parent helping the child set a self-chosen barrier
exampleSpecs.stakes: confidence on the field needs review done before Saturday
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the child decides the whistle stays in the study box until three offside cards are explained
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A referee whistle rests inside a clear study box.

exampleSpecs.domain: middle-school poet avoiding revision by browsing prompts
exampleSpecs.audience: teacher guiding a pact without taking control
exampleSpecs.stakes: revision ownership matters more than compliance
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, prompts replace revision; after, the student seals prompt cards in an envelope until one stanza is revised
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A sealed prompt envelope sits beside a penciled stanza.

exampleSpecs.domain: child caring for a rabbit before screen time
exampleSpecs.audience: caregiver helping make an owned pact for animal care
exampleSpecs.stakes: the rabbit depends on action before entertainment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the child invents the rule that the hay scoop hangs on the console shelf until the hutch is checked
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A hay scoop hangs from a console shelf hook.

exampleSpecs.domain: teen preparing language flashcards for a family trip
exampleSpecs.audience: older cousin helping with a pact the teen can revise
exampleSpecs.stakes: travel confidence grows when study happens before scrolling
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they review a failed pact and the teen changes it to ten cards before the charger leaves the drawer
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A passport sleeve sits beside a stack of language cards.

exampleSpecs.domain: young swimmer managing early-morning practice packing
exampleSpecs.stakes: forgotten gear creates conflict at dawn
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the swimmer chooses that goggles clip to the backpack only after the bag is fully packed
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A goggles case clips to a backpack zipper pull.
